name: Group Meeting (组会)
description: Research group meeting: per-person progress, advisor feedback, and next steps.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Give a one-paragraph overview of what the group covered and the overall direction agreed on.

sections.title: Progress by Person
sections.instruction: For each presenter, summarize what they reported: results, experiments, drafts, and blockers. Use the speaker's name when it is clear from the transcript.

sections.title: Advisor Feedback
sections.instruction: List concrete feedback, critiques, and suggestions from the advisor or senior members, attributed to whom it was directed.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: List decisions made about research direction, paper plans, deadlines, or methods.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List assigned tasks with owner and deadline, with the transcript timestamp for reference.
